## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e0c2d1f2775dc554a4dc673e465477cf35bc6a9e`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #13074 (body, triage `6275938860`, claim `6276596320`, os-dev-report `6276962398`), PR #13087 (body, 8 files, net diff against `main` at `2493e85a39`), the head's check-runs, and the sources the diff names, read at the base sha (`PageView.tsx`, `pageRecordActions.ts`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`, `PageView.relatedListActions-12870.test.tsx`, the record blocks' gate, `hasCapabilities`) plus the spec's `view.zod.ts` and `audience-required-permissions.ts`.

Check-runs on the head at review time: completed green — Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Overwrite Report, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Line Citation Gate, Live E2E (informational), label; skipped — coverage jobs, dependabot. STILL IN PROGRESS (not awaited, per the brief): Lint, Type Check, Repo Gates, Build and E2E, Build Docs, Bundle Analysis, Test (dist pins), Test shards 1 to 16 of 16. No derived gate has failed; none of the test or type-check families has answered yet.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set / public-surface changes the diff implies**

1. `list-view` (and the `list` alias registration) publishes `requiredPermissions` (`array`, `of: 'string'`) — **right.** The reader is `ListViewBlock`'s new gate: `Array.isArray(handOff.requiredPermissions)`, `required.length > 0 && !perms.hasCapabilities(required)`, the notice `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"` "Insufficient permissions to view list.", returned before `ElementDataSourceGate`, so no view is resolved and no `find` is sent. That is the same helper and, line for line, the same predicate and the same markup as `record-details.tsx` / `record-related-list.tsx` / `record-highlights.tsx` (`required.length > 0 && !perms.hasCapabilities(required)`, same notice shape, only the noun differs). "A provider that reports no capabilities leaves the list shown" IS the record blocks' semantics: `hasCapabilities` returns `true` when `systemPermissions` is not an array (objectui#4656, written on `PermissionContextValue.hasCapabilities` and in `MePermissionsProvider`), and `record-details.tsx` carries the same warning paragraph. A reported `[]` gates strictly; the pin's `held: []` row measures that. The spec's describe (`AUDIENCE_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS_DESCRIPTION`) declares the same shape and ALL-of semantics as the app / navigation / action / record-block keys and says the server enforces it on served items; a client gate on an embedded page node is the renderer gap the card named, and the code and docs correctly leave the object list page (server-gated) alone. Hook order is sound: every hook (`useContext`, `useMemo`, `usePageRegionPosture`, `useRelatedRecordActions`, `useObjectTranslation`, `usePermissions`) runs before the early return. Pins: seven rows through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `import '../index'`, fixtures parsed by the spec's own `list-view` row, under a real stock `MePermissionsProvider`, with an absent-key control for a viewer holding nothing, a full-grant control beside the partial-grant row, and the unreported-provider row. The reported ablation (`false &&` on the gate: 2 failed / 13 passed, blob restored to `eba5fd8e3b56` == the head's `ListViewBlock.tsx` blob, which GitHub confirms) is consistent with those rows. **This half is honoured, measured, and publishable.**

2. `list-view` publishes `addRecord` (`object`) — **wrong: published without a measured renderer in the host it is described for, and the description, the member pin, the changeset, the README and the mdx all state a console behaviour that the base `main` closes by source and by an existing pin.**
   - The block routes the click through `useRelatedRecordActions().resolve({ objectName }).onCreate`. On a console custom page, `PageView` mounts `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` with `serve={servePageRecordActions}` and `parentFromList`; the bridge publishes `serve(value)`, i.e. `pageRecordActionsValue(..., bridge)`. Its `resolve` is `pageRelatedHandlers(related, input)`, which returns the frozen `NO_RELATED_HANDLERS` whenever `input.parentId` is empty — and `ListViewBlock` passes `{ objectName }` only, so `parentId` is always empty — and even under a parent serves ONLY `onRowAction` / `onToolbarAction`. Its docblock says so verbatim: "The bridge's other members (New, Edit, Delete, row click, ...) would change what a page list ... draws, and that list is unchanged by this card." The objectui#12870 pin's CONTROL row asserts "no New" on a page list. So on every console page the block's `handlers?.onCreate` is `undefined` and the button is WITHHELD — `addRecord` remains inert in the console, now silently (no button) instead of visibly (a dead button).
   - The dev's premise statement ("the page path had a create handler available through RelatedRecordActionsBridge (PageView mounts it with parentFromList)") is wrong: the bridge builds `onCreate`, but the page's `serve` strips it before it reaches the context. The PR body's "in the console it opens the global record-form overlay (`form=new` with `formObject`)" is a source reading of the bridge alone, not of what the page publishes, and it was not measured — no pin mounts `PageView`.
   - The pins that exist measure the block under a synthetic host (`makeHost`) that answers `onCreate` for any object. That proves the block's contract against `RelatedRecordActionsContext` (click calls `onCreate`, `resolve` asked with `{ objectName: 'crm_task' }`, `position: 'both'` dispatches twice, withheld with no `onCreate` / `createDisabled` / no host, control with no key never calls `resolve`). Those rows and their ablations (2/13, 3/12, restores proven) are real and honest for what they test. But objectui#11111 decision 3 = B and the card's Target ("`addRecord` should open the create flow the object list uses") ask for a renderer that acts on the page node where it is served, and the one host that serves page nodes publishes no `onCreate`. A library consumer mounting its own provider with `onCreate` would get a working button; the console does not, and every published sentence says the console does.
   - Soundness of the routing for a node under no related-records host: the button is withheld, by the test's "no host" row — right as far as it goes, and consistent with the context's own doctrine ("an omitted handler hides its affordance"). The departure from the related list's "+ New" semantics on `createDisabled` (withheld rather than greyed, because `ListView` has no disabled Add button) is disclosed in code, description and docs; acceptable on its own.
   - A host `onAddRecord` prop still winning is consistent with the explicit-adapter precedence this block already applies to `dataSource`; no page passes it, so it is unreachable on the page path and changes nothing for `ObjectView`.

3. Parity rows and member pins — `list-view.requiredPermissions` and `list-view.addRecord` struck from `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS`; `LIST_VIEW_13074_PIN_FILE` added; two `MEMBER_PINS` entries pointing at the new file. The `requiredPermissions` pin text matches the rows in the file exactly. The `addRecord` pin text says the click opens "the record-form overlay the object list opens" — that sentence is not what the pin file measures (it measures a stub `onCreate`) and is false on the console page at the base, per item 2. Struck honestly for `requiredPermissions`; struck on a wrong premise for `addRecord`.

4. Docs (`packages/plugin-list/README.md`, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-list.mdx`) — the `requiredPermissions` paragraphs state what the code does (ALL required, the notice, no query, empty/absent no gate, unreported provider leaves the list shown, page node only). The `addRecord` paragraphs state "The console opens the object's create form with it, the same form the object list's New button opens" — not true at this base. The `sharing` sentences are right.

5. `ListViewBlock.specInputs-13047.test.tsx` — deleting the two "inert" rows is legitimate ONLY for a key that is now honoured and pinned elsewhere, which the header edit says. For `requiredPermissions` that holds (the old row's assertion "a capability nobody holds still draws and queries" would now fail, and the replacement pins are stronger). For `addRecord` the old row measured exactly the console-relevant fact — "draws an Add button that does nothing on a page node, which has no host `onAddRecord`" — and on the console page the truthful successor is "draws NO Add button", which nothing now measures. The deletion is inside the claimed "tests beside them" surface, and the dev flagged it as deviation (2); it is procedurally fine and substantively half right.

6. `sharing` stays unpublished, with its control row (Share click changes nothing) and the registration assertion — right.

7. No new export, no new host prop, no `ListView` change, no `@object-ui/types` change — right; `handOff.requiredPermissions` and `bound.addRecord` type-check against the existing `ListViewSchema` (the dev's local `type-check` exited 0; CI Type Check is still running).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/13074-list-view-inert-keys.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-list` `minor`. The diff adds published registry inputs and new page-node behaviour in a released package's `src/`, and also touches `apps/console/src/__tests__` (a fixed-group package, so one changeset covers both; `check-changeset-presence` reports "1 changeset declared for 2 released packages changed"). `minor` is the right level for a widened accept-set and is the ceiling AGENTS.md allows (never `major`, fixed group; `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`). The changeset body states the two keys and the `sharing` exclusion; its `addRecord` sentence ("on a page it now opens the object's create form, the one the object list opens") inherits the ① item 2 defect and must be corrected with whatever fix lands. `Clause-②: yes` in the PR body matches the dispatch ("yes if `requiredPermissions` / `addRecord` is published"). Changeset Declaration, Claim Re-read, Bump Policy, Overwrite Report and Fixed Group checks are all green on the head. Level: right; text: wrong on one sentence.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: `[]`** — none to answer. The report should have carried one: whether the page host actually serves `onCreate`. It does not (① item 2).
- **Deviation (1)** (dispatch's Gates clause vs Lock clause; targeted files run, directories declared to CI): accepted; the shard and type-check runs are the arbiter and are in progress.
- **Deviation (2)** (editing objectui#13047's measurement file): accepted as a surface matter; see ① item 5 for the substantive half.
- **Deviation (3)** (no labels written): accepted; `labeler.yml` applied `documentation`, `plugin`, `apps`, `tests`.
- **PR body is stale against its own head.** The Acceptance note "Docs ... were not touched. Carrier: none." and the report's `files_changed` (6 files) predate the second commit; the head carries `README.md` and `plugin-list.mdx` (8 files). The dispatching seat should amend the PR body when it adopts a verdict.
- **Out-of-scope finding (console object list: `renderListView` passes `addRecord` without `onAddRecord`)** — a source reading with no carrier; it is a second instance of the same class as ① item 2 and belongs on a card. Escalated to the seat as a filing candidate, not judged here.
- **Out-of-scope finding (page `openChildForm` ignores `editMode: 'page'`)** — moot until the page host serves `onCreate`; carry with the fix.
- **Required fix, named so the dev can act without a second reading:** either (a) make the console page host serve the create path — extend `pageRelatedHandlers` / `servePageRecordActions` (app-shell, OUTSIDE the claimed file surface: a claim amendment is needed) to pass the bridge's `onCreate` / `createDisabled` for a list with no parent, and add a pin through the real `PageView` (the objectui#12870 file's shape) showing a page `list-view` node's Add button pushes `form=new` + `formObject`, with the 12870 CONTROL row re-examined since it asserts "no New"; or (b) land `requiredPermissions` alone — keep `addRecord` out of `inputs`, restore its parity row (reworded: the button is withheld on a page node, never drawn dead), keep the new block-level pins as the renderer's contract, and drop the console sentences from the description, the member pin, the changeset, the README and the mdx. Either way the `addRecord` sentences that claim console behaviour cannot ship as written.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-13074-list-view-inert-keys`
Reviewed-by: `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Ruling on the contract review (FAIL) of PR #13087 · `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`)

The seat re-read the review's central claim on `main`. `packages/app-shell/src/views/pageRecordActions.ts:41` returns `NO_RELATED_HANDLERS` when `parentId` is empty, and under a parent the function serves only `onRowAction` / `onToolbarAction`. So on a console page a `list-view` node's Add button is withheld, which contradicts every sentence that says the console opens a create form. **Confirmed.**

**Ruling: option (b).** This PR lands `requiredPermissions` alone. The page host serving `onCreate` (option (a)) would widen into app-shell and reverse the objectui#12870 CONTROL row ("no New" on a page list). That is a deliberate pinned behaviour, so it goes to its own card: **filed objectui#13089**. #13089 also carries the review's two out-of-scope findings: `renderListView` passes `addRecord` without `onAddRecord`, and page `openChildForm` ignores `editMode: 'page'`.

Patch round for PR #13087, on the same branch `claude/issue-13074-list-view-inert-keys`:

1. Take `addRecord` out of the `list-view` / `list` registration `inputs`. Restore its `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` row, reworded to state the measured fact: on a page node the Add button is withheld, because the page host serves no `onCreate`. Cite objectui#13089. Drop the `list-view.addRecord` `MEMBER_PINS` entry.
2. Keep the block-level routing code and its pins (`resolve({ objectName }).onCreate`, withheld with no host / no `onCreate` / `createDisabled`, `position: 'both'`). Their titles must describe a provider that serves `onCreate`, not "the console". Add one row, or reuse the restored inert row in `ListViewBlock.specInputs-13047.test.tsx`, that measures "no Add button on a page node under no `onCreate` host". That row is the truthful successor to the deleted "dead button" row.
3. Remove every sentence that claims a console create form from the registration description, the changeset, `packages/plugin-list/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-list.mdx`. Each may keep `requiredPermissions` and the `sharing` exclusion. The changeset stays `minor`.
4. Run the targeted tests and type-check, push, and report back. The seat PATCHes the PR body and asks for a re-review of the delta.
